sources.quote: Delta Sagittarii, formally named Kaus Media, is a star in the southern zodiac constellation of Sagittarius.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 1,393 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,333 K, so 66.322 solar radii.
